# Candydati

> Open, self-hostable agentic ATS (applicant tracking system) built for candidates: salary in clear, declared process,
> an answer to every applicant, no automated decisions about people. Source: https://github.com/fabrilallo/candydati

## Install or host Candydati (for AI agents)

- [Deploy skill](https://github.com/fabrilallo/candydati/blob/main/skills/candydati-deploy/SKILL.md): the steps an AI
  coding agent follows to deploy Candydati on the user's Dokploy through its API (or on a fresh server). It needs only
  Dokploy's URL and an API key from the user; secrets and domain are generated, email is set later in the app.

## Documentation

- [Quick start](https://fabrilallo.github.io/candydati/guide/quick-start): one-command install on a fresh server
- [Other deployments](https://fabrilallo.github.io/candydati/guide/other-deployments): Dokploy, Docker Compose
- [Email](https://fabrilallo.github.io/candydati/guide/email): SMTP or Resend, configured from the app
- [Migration skill](https://github.com/fabrilallo/candydati/blob/main/skills/candydati-migration/SKILL.md): move data
  from another ATS
